title: Replication Data for: EAL study 3
descriptions: The data concern the SPSS 28 data set of a PhD’s third study (reflective practice in EAL). The study compared the effects of different levels of reflective practice in an EAL course on knowledge transfer, reflective thinking and learning performance. EAL is English as Additional Language.
